title: Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) Master Specification v1.1
abstract: Canonical master specification of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), which models the universe as a thermodynamic-information system driven by energy-flow and entropy gradients. It formalizes three base layers—EFC-S (structure/halos), EFC-D (energy-flow dynamics), and EFC-C0 (entropy–information mapping)—and fixes baseline fields, notation, and equations to enable unambiguous higher-level models and simulations.
